entry.title: Flood Evacuation Wairoa - Wairoa River
entry.content: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <alert xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:emergency:cap:1.2"><identifier>2.49.0.0.554.2.6.489.489</identifier><sender>enquiries@hbemergency.govt.nz</sender><sent>2026-07-09T09:42:27-00:00</sent><status>Actual</status><msgType>Alert</msgType><scope>Public</scope><info><language>en-US</language><category>Met</category><event>Wairoa Flooding 090726</event><urgency>Immediate</urgency><severity>Severe</severity><certainty>Observed</certainty><effective>2026-07-09T09:42:27-00:00</effective><expires>2026-07-09T13:12:27-00:00</expires><senderName>Hawke's Bay Civil Defence Emergency Management Group</senderName><headline>Flood Evacuation Wairoa - Wairoa River</headline><description>CIVIL DEFENCE FLOOD WARNING: EVACUATE NOW. EVACUATE in you are in a low-lying area near the Wairoa River, including houses between Outram Street and Grant Street, and Kopu Road and Apatu Street. EVACUATE to higher ground or inland. People in this area must leave now, take essential items and pets with you. If lives are in immediate danger dial 111. Avoid travelling through flood water if possible. Stay out of flooded areas until advised by officials. Organise to stay with friends or family if you can, or go to Wairoa War Memorial Hall a Civil Defence Centres will be established there to provided assistance There is serious flooding in low-lying area of Wairoa from the Wairoa River. For more information visit, www.facebook.com/wairoadistrictcouncil www.hbemergency.govt.nz. Issued by Hawke's Bay Civil Defence Emergency Management: 9.42 7/9/26</description><area><areaDesc>HBEM-FL12: Wairoa River – North Clyde & Wairoa</areaDesc><polygon>-39.06837,177.391 -39.05913,177.45388 -39.03485,177.45721 -39.01336,177.43616 -39.0211,177.38546 -39.04216,177.36164 -39.0572,177.37023 -39.06837,177.391</polygon></area></info></alert>
